surface_mechanism_description: The growth process involves the reaction of InCl3 and H2S precursors, with the thermodynamic favorability of the reaction being compared to the In2O3 process. The reaction equation provided is 2 InCl3(g) + 3 H2S(g) = In2S3(s) + 6 HCl(g), with a negative Gibbs free energy change indicating a favorable reaction.
